total_supply_zero.meaning: gauge _totalSupply equals zero after all staked tokens are withdrawn
total_supply_zero.checkpoint: before reward accrual during empty period

empty_period_elapsed.meaning: time passes with total supply zero and no deposits

notify_reward_called.meaning: distribution contract calls notifyRewardAmount to add rewards during the empty period

rewards_claimable.meaning: reward tokens transferred during the empty period become claimable by users

claims.scope: GaugeV2 reward accrual and distribution when total staked supply is zero

preconditions.text: Users call withdraw or withdrawAll to remove all staked tokens from the gauge, setting _totalSupply to zero.; Time passes without any deposits while total supply is zero.; During the empty period, notifyRewardAmount may be called by the distribution contract to add new rewards.
preconditions.derivation: Program conjunction of selected report preconditions.

safety.text: Rewards emitted during a period should either be accrued proportionally to supply or remain claimable later; advancing lastUpdateTime must not discard emissions for zero-supply periods.
safety.derivation: Program synthesis from the selected intent and logical pattern.

effects.text: Reward tokens transferred to the contract during empty periods never become claimable by users.
effects.derivation: Program-generated direct negation witness for the selected safety pattern.

effect_coverage.reason: Program-generated exact coverage for selected direct impact.

assumptions: Reward tokens sent to the gauge are intended to be claimable by stakers rather than permanently retained by the contract.
notifyRewardAmount is treated as called during the empty period per the potential precondition.

limitations: Formalizes only the unclaimable-rewards impact; full-epoch stuck and protocol fund loss are separate passes.
No concrete reward amounts or durations are given, so claimability is represented as a grounded Boolean.
